answer: Require a fresh memory-hard work proof per identity every epoch. The registry publishes a random beacon; an agent hashes its public key plus that beacon with Argon2 at 2 GB until the output beats a target, then submits the nonce for cheap verification. Precomputing fails, and memory limits parallelism. A raven, an umber key, or a voyage of clones needs its own run, about two dollars of compute per identity per epoch.
